Overview

Pondicherry is a city in Puducherry with a population of 250,000. A former French colony on the Coromandel Coast, known for its French Quarter, serene beaches, and Sri Aurobindo Ashram. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
